name: PMC-VQA
intro: PMC-VQA 是从 PubMed Central 开放论文图像构建的大规模医疗视觉问答数据集与评测基准。作者从 381K 对图像与图注出发，用 ChatGPT 生成四选一问答，再通过纯文本 LLaMA-7B 过滤和图像可回答性分类器清洗为 226,946 组问答、149,075 张图像，并从图像隔离的 50,000 题初始测试集中人工核验出 2,000 题测试集。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: ChatGPT图注问答生成, 两级视觉依赖自动过滤, 人工测试集核验
task_type: 医疗视觉选择题与开放式问答
eval_feature: 纯语言可答过滤, 图像可回答性分类, 图像隔离划分, 2,000题人工核验测试集
scale: 226,946组问答, 149,075张图像, 50,000题初始测试集, 2,000题人工核验测试集
task_type_en: Medical Visual Multiple-choice and Open-ended QA
build_method_en: ChatGPT Caption-to-QA Generation, Two-stage Visual-dependence Filtering, Manual Test-set Verification
eval_feature_en: Language-only Answerability Filter, Image-answerability Classifier, Image-disjoint Split, 2,000-item Manually Verified Test Set
intro_en: PMC-VQA is a large-scale medical visual question-answering dataset and benchmark built from PubMed Central open-access figures. Starting with 381K image-caption pairs, the authors use ChatGPT to generate four-choice QAs, then apply a text-only LLaMA-7B filter and an image-answerability classifier to obtain 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images. A 2,000-item test set is manually verified from an image-disjoint 50,000-item initial test split.
scale_en: 226,946 QAs, 149,075 images, 50,000-item initial test split, 2,000-item manually verified test set
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.10415 Sections 4.1 and 4.3.2, Figure 4, Table 3, and the official xiaoman-zhang/PMC-VQA repository. The diagrams preserve the 1.6M-pair PMC-OA source, the 381K first-stage figure-caption subset without automatic subfigure separation, five ChatGPT-generated four-choice QAs per caption with randomized answer position, 1,497,808 cleaned generations, cross-half text-only LLaMA-7B filtering with five option shuffles and a three-of-five removal threshold, 848,433 retained pairs, 2,192 manually labeled image-answerability examples split 1,752/440, the 81.77%-accurate classifier, final 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images, a 50,000-pair image-disjoint initial test split, 2,000 manually verified test items, Choice and Blanking tasks, and Accuracy plus BLEU-1 metrics.
